correctness.rationale: The m even-modulation characters diagonalize the two-translate synthesis into m independent sqrt(m) times 2x2 polyphase matrices B_(r,d). Their frame eigenvalues are m/2 [tau +/- sqrt(tau²-4Delta²)]. Strictly positive decreasing geodesic radial weights give h(j)=w_ell(j)/w_(m-ell(j)); h(j) decreases strictly in ell(j), and equality of h(r),h(r-d) requires 2r=d mod 2m. This has exactly one r for even d and none for odd d, proving rank 2m-1 versus 2m and the m² design count. For g=rho^ell, determinants equal 2rho^m sinh(t(d-2r)) for r<d and -2rho^m sinh(td) for r>=d, giving V_d product. Consecutive allowed odd-distance ratio is [sinh((d+2)t)/sinh(dt)]^(m-d-1)>1. Independent full 2x2 determinant/volume checks for m=2..10 at rho=.43 confirmed every parity and exact product up to floating tolerance; analytic proof covers all positive rho and dimensions.
